message.reasoning_content:
We need to parse problem: She currently has stuffed animals: 3 puppies, 5 koala bears, 2 zebras, 4 frogs. Total currently = 3+5+2+4 = 14 stuffed animals.

She wants to buy stuffed goats such that goats constitute 30% of all her stuffed animals (including goats). Let x = number of goats to buy. Then goats / (total + x) = 0.30. Total currently = 14. So x / (14 + x) = 0.30. Solve: x = 0.30*(14 + x) => x = 4.2 + 0.30x => x - 0.30x = 4.2 => 0.70x = 4.2 => x = 4.2 / 0.70 = 6. So x = 6. Check: total after = 14+6=20, goats =6, proportion =6/20=0.30. Yes integer.

Thus answer: 6.
